spec.prompt: Aerial view looking down past the orange-and-white parachute canopy and the swinging spherical capsule toward an endless snow-covered Ural taiga forest, dark fir trees and white snow as far as the horizon, no roads, no clearings, overcast March light. Slow spiralling descent, the trees getting closer. Photorealistic, shot on 35mm film, IMAX documentary realism in the spirit of Apollo 11 (2019) and Gravity. Accurate 1965 Soviet hardware: the white Berkut spacesuit with rust-orange harness straps, a white helmet with red CCCP letters above the visor, Soviet markings only. Hard directional sunlight, deep black space, crisp silhouettes. No on-screen text, no captions.
